name: Automate Attention
description: A fully on-chain generative NFT whose art and text are computed live by an on-chain LLM and SVG generator.
about:
## Automate Attention

Automate Attention (`AATTN`) is a fully on-chain ERC-721 collection. Nothing about a token is stored as a static file: each `tokenURI` is computed live from other contracts every time it is read.

### Render pipeline

`AutomateAttention.tokenURI` delegates to a **Renderer** (`0x6e8f02f70939ad8fa1497c6b3be5007c9100384e`), which:

1. Runs an on-chain large language model, **OnChainLMv2** (`0x5f8e7d750e75b44747c058a204d8dea0d18fa5d3`), to generate a short aphorism for the token.
2. Calls **ArtGenerator** (`0xcd84bc27d62e335cea20d1dff70d53f815489e16`), which dispatches across 23 art types to three sub-generators — **ArtGenA** (`0xd1f1d32aada5d09c602cf87e69d1d6d4fa6fa520`), **ArtGenB** (`0xa181e023e476a759f2423f02d61713db606fb45c`), and **ArtGenC** (`0x368934224d01230de6d6005fce4fe85ab37cee8c`) — to build an SVG.
3. Packs the aphorism, SVG, and traits into a base64 `data:application/json` metadata URI.

### Minting

Minting is a flat 0.01 ETH via `mint()`. The first mint arms a rolling 24-hour window; every subsequent mint resets it. Once the 24-hour deadline passes with no mint, minting closes permanently and can never reopen.

### Traits

Two traits are fixed at mint time and packed into one byte per token:

- **State / prefix** — derived from the time since the previous mint: `crowded` (< 5 min), `rising` (< 1 h), `falling` (< 6 h), or `scarce` (≥ 6 h). It selects the LLM prompt and the art pool.
- **Wealth** — derived from the minter's ETH balance at mint time: `dust`, `modest` (≥ 0.1 ETH), `holder` (≥ 1 ETH), or `whale` (≥ 10 ETH). It shifts the generated art.

The project source describes itself as "a vv inspired project by diid."
risks: Rolling 24h window — once the deadline passes with no mint, minting closes permanently and cannot reopen
mint() requires exactly 0.01 ETH — any other amount reverts

The current owner is the Dopamine contract; its public withdrawal flow pulls and splits collected ETH, and its creator can transfer Automate Attention ownership to any nonzero address without a timelock
The wealth trait records the minter's approximate ETH balance at mint time onchain

mint.title: Mint
mint.description: Mint one token at the flat 0.01 ETH price while minting is open.
mint.intent: Mint an Automate Attention token for 0.01 ETH
mint.warning: Sends exactly 0.01 ETH. Any other amount reverts, and minting closes forever once the 24-hour deadline passes.

currentPrice.title: Current Price
currentPrice.description: The flat mint price. Always 0.01 ETH.

mintDeadline.title: Mint Deadline
mintDeadline.description: Last Unix timestamp at which minting remains open. Returns 0 before the first mint.

mintEnded.title: Mint Ended
mintEnded.description: True once the rolling 24h window has lapsed. Permanent once true.

MINT_PRICE.title: Mint Price Constant
MINT_PRICE.description: The fixed per-token mint price (0.01 ETH).

MINT_WINDOW.title: Mint Window
MINT_WINDOW.description: The rolling window length that keeps minting open (24 hours).

tokenPrefix.title: Token State
tokenPrefix.description: The market-state trait a token was minted into.

tokenWealth.title: Token Wealth
tokenWealth.description: The wealth tier derived from the minter's ETH balance at mint time.

tokenData.title: Token Data
tokenData.description: Raw packed trait byte: low 2 bits are state, next 2 bits are wealth.

renderer.title: Renderer
renderer.description: The Renderer contract that builds each token's metadata onchain.

CROWDED_THRESHOLD.title: Crowded Threshold
CROWDED_THRESHOLD.description: Below this gap since the last mint, a token is tagged crowded.

RISING_THRESHOLD.title: Rising Threshold
RISING_THRESHOLD.description: Below this gap since the last mint, a token is tagged rising.

FALLING_THRESHOLD.title: Falling Threshold
FALLING_THRESHOLD.description: Below this gap since the last mint, a token is tagged falling.

MODEST_THRESHOLD.title: Modest Threshold
MODEST_THRESHOLD.description: Minimum minter balance for the modest wealth tier (0.1 ETH).

HOLDER_THRESHOLD.title: Holder Threshold
HOLDER_THRESHOLD.description: Minimum minter balance for the holder wealth tier (1 ETH).

WHALE_THRESHOLD.title: Whale Threshold
WHALE_THRESHOLD.description: Minimum minter balance for the whale wealth tier (10 ETH).

nextTokenId.title: Next Token ID
nextTokenId.description: The token ID the next mint will assign.

lastMintTimestamp.title: Last Mint Time
lastMintTimestamp.description: Unix time of the most recent mint. Zero before the first mint.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: The address that can withdraw ETH and transfer ownership.

withdraw.title: Withdraw
withdraw.description: Send the full contract ETH balance to the owner. Only the owner can call this.
withdraw.warning: Owner-only. Transfers the entire collected mint balance to the owner address.

transferOwnership.title: Transfer Ownership
transferOwnership.description: Transfer contract ownership to a new address. Only the owner can call this.
transferOwnership.warning: Owner-only. The new owner gains full admin control, including ETH withdrawal.

Minted.title: Minted
Minted.description: Emitted when a token is minted, recording its state and wealth traits.

Withdrawn.title: Withdrawn
Withdrawn.description: Emitted when the owner withdraws the contract's ETH balance.
